title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 1+1 NE KOMUNEN E PARISIT
description_sq:
Prona pozicionohet ne katin e peste te nje objekti te ri ngjitur me qendren tregtare "Kristal". 
Apartamenti ka hapsira shume te rregullta, organizohet ne koridor qe ben shperndarjen e ambienteve, ambient ndenje, dhome gjumi dhe tualet me dritare. (Ballkoni eshte i mbyllur por kthehet shum lehte ne funksion veten me vendosjen e nje vetrate)
Prona sapo eshte rinovuar totalisht, investimet e kryera ne prone jane: sistem i ri i rrjetit elektrik, sistem i ri i rrjetit hidraulik, durale te reja me eficence maksimale termo dhe izoizolim, patinimi dhe tavanet e varura, shtrimi i parketit, sistemi i kondicionimit etj. 
Apartamenti ka pamje te lire dhe orientim Jug qe em favorizon shume ndricimin e prones. 
Aksesi dhe vendodhja e bejne kete prone shume te pershtatshme si per banim po ashtu edhe per investim.
Per me shume info na kontaktoni.
title_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PARIS
description_en: The property is positioned on the fifth floor of a new building adjacent to the shopping center "Kristal". The apartment has very neat spaces, it is organized in a corridor that distributes the premises, a living room, a bedroom and a bathroom with a window. (The balcony is closed, but it is very easy to return to function by placing a window) The property has just been completely renovated, the investments made in the property are: new electrical network system, new hydraulic network system, new durals with maximum thermal efficiency and insulation, patination and suspended ceilings, parquet laying, air conditioning system, etc. The apartment has an unobstructed view and South orientation, which greatly favors the lighting of the property. Access and location make this property very suitable for both residence and investment. For more information, contact us.
